about_the_game:
Ok listen up. By popular demand... this is the artbook for the game Lovely Lady RPG! This is not the game itself, mind!

The Official Lovely Lady RPG Artbook, features over 100 pages of Kunstkollektiv ramblings about the game. NOT to be missed.

Note that all content warnings from the actual games's page apply! Contains graphic content and dirt!
